passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.3
passages.text: Pyrrhus Achillides, animosus imagine patris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.4
passages.text: Inclusam contra iusque piumque tenet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.5
passages.text: Quod potui, renui, ne non invita tenerer;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.6
passages.text: Cetera femineae non valuere manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.7
passages.text: 'Quid facis, Aeacide? non sum sine vindice,' dixi:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.8
passages.text: 'Haec tibi sub domino est, Pyrrhe, puella suo!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.9
passages.text: Surdior ille freto clamantem nomen Orestae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.10
passages.text: Traxit inornatis in sua tecta comis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.11
passages.text: Quid gravius capta Lacedaemone serva tulissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.12
passages.text: Si raperet Graias barbara turba nurus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.13
passages.text: Parcius Andromachen vexavit Achaia victrix,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.14
passages.text: Cum Danaus Phrygias ureret ignis opes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.15
passages.text: At tu, cura mei si te pia tangit, Oreste,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.16
passages.text: Inice non timidas in tua iura manus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.17
passages.text: An siquis rapiat stabulis armenta reclusis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.18
passages.text: Arma feras, rapta coniuge lentus eris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.19
passages.text: Sit socer exemplo nuptae repetitor ademptae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.20
passages.text: Cui pia militiae causa puella fuit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.21
passages.text: Si socer ignavus vidua stertisset in aula,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.22
passages.text: Nupta foret Paridi mater, ut ante fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.23
passages.text: Nec tu mille rates sinuosaque vela pararis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.24
passages.text: Nec numeros Danai militis — ipse veni!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.25
passages.text: Sic quoque eram repetenda tamen, nec turpe marito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.26
passages.text: Aspera pro caro bella tulisse toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.27
passages.text: Quid, quod avus nobis idem Pelopeius Atreus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.28
passages.text: Et, si non esses vir mihi, frater eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.29
passages.text: Vir, precor, uxori, frater succurre sorori!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.30
passages.text: Instant officio nomina bina tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.31
passages.text: Me tibi Tyndareus, vita gravis auctor et annis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.32
passages.text: Tradidit; arbitrium neptis habebat avus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.33
passages.text: At pater Aeacidae promiserat inscius acti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.34
passages.text: Plus patre, quo prior est ordine, pollet avus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.35
passages.text: Cum tibi nubebam, nulli mea taeda nocebat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.36
passages.text: Si iungar Pyrrho, tu mihi laesus eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.37
passages.text: Et pater ignoscet nostro Menelaus amori —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.38
passages.text: Succubuit telis praepetis ipse dei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.39
passages.text: Quem sibi permisit, genero concedet amorem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.40
passages.text: Proderit exemplo mater amata suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.41
passages.text: Tu mihi, quod matri pater est; quas egerat olim

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.42
passages.text: Dardanius partis advena, Pyrrhus agit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.43
passages.text: Ille licet patriis sine fine superbiat actis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.44
passages.text: Et tu, quae referas facta parentis, habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.45
passages.text: Tantalides omnis ipsumque regebat Achillem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.46
passages.text: Hic pars militiae; dux erat ille ducum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.47
passages.text: Tu quoque per proavum Pelopem Pelopisque parentem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.48
passages.text: Si medios numeres, a Iove quintus eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.49
passages.text: Nec virtute cares. arma invidiosa tulisti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.50
passages.text: Sed tibi — quid faceres? — induit illa pater.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.51
passages.text: Materia vellem fortis meliore fuisses;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.52
passages.text: Non lecta est operi, sed data causa tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.53
passages.text: Hanc tamen inplesti; iuguloque Aegisthus aperto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.54
passages.text: Tecta cruentavit, quae pater ante tuus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.55
passages.text: Increpat Aeacides laudemque in crimina vertit —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.56
passages.text: Et tamen adspectus sustinet ille meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.57
passages.text: Rumpor, et ora mihi pariter cum mente tumescunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.58
passages.text: Pectoraque inclusis ignibus usta dolent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.59
passages.text: Hermione coram quisquamne obiecit Orestae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.60
passages.text: Nec mihi sunt vires, nec ferus ensis adest?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.61
passages.text: Flere licet certe; flendo defundimus iram,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.62
passages.text: Perque sinum lacrimae fluminis instar eunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.63
passages.text: Has solas habeo semper semperque profundo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.64
passages.text: Ument incultae fonte perenne genae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.65
passages.text: Num generis fato, quod nostros errat in annos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.66
passages.text: Tantalides matres apta rapina sumus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.67
passages.text: Non ego fluminei referam mendacia cygni

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.68
passages.text: Nec querar in plumis delituisse Iovem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.69
passages.text: Qua duo porrectus longe freta distinet Isthmos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.70
passages.text: Vecta peregrinis Hippodamia rotis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.71
passages.text: Taenaris Idaeo trans aequor ab hospite rapta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.72
passages.text: Argolicas pro se vertit in arma manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.75
passages.text: Vix equidem memini, memini tamen. omnia luctus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.76
passages.text: Omnia solliciti plena timoris erant;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.77
passages.text: Flebat avus Phoebeque soror fratresque gemelli,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.78
passages.text: Orabat superos Leda suumque Iovem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.79
passages.text: Ipsa ego, non longos etiamtunc scissa capillos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.80
passages.text: Clamabam: 'sine me, me sine, mater, abis?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.81
passages.text: Nam coniunx aberat! ne non Pelopeia credar,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.82
passages.text: Ecce, Neoptolemo praeda parata fui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.83
passages.text: Pelides utinam vitasset Apollinis arcus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.84
passages.text: Damnaret nati facta proterva pater;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.85
passages.text: Nec quondam placuit nec nunc placuisset Achilli

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.86
passages.text: Abducta viduum coniuge flere virum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.87
passages.text: Quae mea caelestis iniuria fecit iniquos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.88
passages.text: Quod mihi — vae miserae! — sidus obesse querar?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.89
passages.text: Parva mea sine matre fui, pater arma ferebat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.90
passages.text: Et duo cum vivant, orba duobus eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.91
passages.text: Non tibi blanditias primis, mea mater, in annis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.92
passages.text: Incerto dictas ore puella tuli;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.93
passages.text: Non ego captavi brevibus tua colla lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.94
passages.text: Nec gremio sedi sarcina grata tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.95
passages.text: Non cultus tibi cura mei, nec pacta marito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.96
passages.text: Intravi thalamos matre parante novos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.97
passages.text: Obvia prodieram reduci tibi — vera fatebor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.98
passages.text: Nec facies nobis nota parentis erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.99
passages.text: Te tamen esse Helenen, quod eras pulcherrima, sensi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.100
passages.text: Ipsa requirebas, quae tua nata foret!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.101
passages.text: Pars haec una mihi, coniunx bene cessit Orestes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.102
passages.text: Is quoque, ni pro se pugnat, ademptus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.103
passages.text: Pyrrhus habet captam reduce et victore parente —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.104
passages.text: Hoc munus nobis diruta Troia dedit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.105
passages.text: Cum tamen altus equis Titan radiantibus instant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.106
passages.text: Perfruor infelix liberiore malo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.107
passages.text: Nox ubi me thalamis ululantem et acerba gementem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.108
passages.text: Condidit in maesto procubuique toro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.109
passages.text: Pro somno lacrimis oculi funguntur obortis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.110
passages.text: Quaque licet, fugio sicut ab hoste virum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.111
passages.text: Saepe malis stupeo rerumque oblita locique

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.112
passages.text: Ignara tetigi Scyria membra manu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.113
passages.text: Utque nefas sensi, male corpora tacta relinquo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.114
passages.text: Et mihi pollutas credor habere manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.115
passages.text: Saepe Neoptolemi pro nomine nomen Orestae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.116
passages.text: Exit, et errorem vocis ut omen amo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.117
passages.text: Per genus infelix iuro generisque parentem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.118
passages.text: Qui freta, qui terras et sua regna quatit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.119
passages.text: Per patris ossa tui, patrui mihi, quae tibi debent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.120
passages.text: Quod se sub tumulo fortiter ulta iacent —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.121
passages.text: Aut ego praemoriar primoque exstinguar in aevo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 8.122
passages.text: Aut ego Tantalidae Tantalis uxor ero!
